title: SSH authorized_keys file served
description: The response is an SSH authorized_keys file: public key entries with their comments. The comments usually name the people or the automation accounts that can log in, and the key types narrow the client versions they use.
remediation: Keep the SSH configuration out of the document root and deny the .ssh directory at the server level.
limitation: One response body. The rule reads public key entries; it does not attempt a login.

observation.body:
from="10.0.0.0/8" ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABgExampleKeyBody backup@host
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIExampleKeyBody ops@bastion
Add the line ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIExampleKeyBody to authorized_keys.
